summary: Frontend-only verification of restructured StoreX (Vite + Express) via public preview URL. All 7 requested flows verified successfully: preview loads, product listing, product details, add-to-cart, auth page routes, and Zod v4 registration validation returning HTTP 400 with a clear message. Only minor UI issues noted.

minor.issue: Error response leaks server 'stack' trace to the client (dev-mode error handler). Body: {status, message, stack: 'Error: ... at /app/server/src/middleware/validate.js:9 ...'}. Should be suppressed in prod.

Logs a console error 'canReview error: You are not logged in.' and returns 401 on the product details page for anonymous users. Expected for guests, but the frontend should treat it silently instead of console.error.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking ADD TO BAG on the product page (no login performed), the header switches from 'SIGN IN' to showing an account/user icon + 'LOGOUT'. Auth state appears to be incorrectly derived from cart presence or a stray token set on add-to-cart. Reproduced on /products/puma-tshirt then /cart.
When backend returns 400 with 'Invalid email, Password must be at least 8 characters', the error is not rendered anywhere in the UI. Form silently stays. User has no feedback.

issues: Looks polished; luxury black/white theme renders as intended.

action_items: Suppress error 'stack' in API error responses (only include in dev, hide in prod) in /app/server/src/middleware error handler.

Fix header auth state: it flips to LOGOUT after adding to cart without any authentication. Likely the cart action stores something the auth selector interprets as logged-in, or LOGOUT is being rendered when a wishlist/user store is initialized.
Show inline error toast/message on /register when API returns 400. Currently the message from the backend is discarded in the UI.
Silence expected 401 from /api/reviews/can-review for guest users (don't console.error).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend error handler leaks stack traces to clients — must be gated on NODE_ENV.
Guest-mode API calls (reviews/can-review) should be gated on auth state to avoid noisy 401s in the browser console.
test_credentials: None used. No login/registration completed (as instructed).
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only browsing + one intentionally-invalid register submit that returned 400.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://d558cfe5-5754-479f-9b3d-d01f1b4b5a8f.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend Vite on 3000, backend Node on 8001, ingress routes /api -> 8001. Products available: 'Puma Tshirt' (slug puma-tshirt, ₹599) and 'Nike Air Max1' (₹1200). Cart is client-side zustand. To test register validation without HTML5 blocking: JS-strip 'required' and change email input type to text before submit — backend returns 400 with proper Zod v4 message. Do NOT complete a real signup (production Neon DB).
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'cannot see code preview' RCA (already fixed by main agent): supervisor pointed to removed Python/CRA. New supervisor config launches Node server on 8001 and Vite on 3000, VITE_API_URL='/api' routes through ingress. Verified end-to-end via public URL.
